def humanize_bytes(n: int) -> str:
    units = ["B", "KiB", "MiB", "GiB", "TiB", "PiB"]
    
    if abs(n) < 1024:
        return f"{n} B"
    
    val = float(n)
    unit_index = 0
    
    # Divide by 1024 while the value is >= 1024 and we haven't reached the max unit (PiB)
    while abs(val) >= 1024 and unit_index < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1024.0
        unit_index += 1
        
    return f"{val:.1f} {units[unit_index]}"
